# Class 18 {.ct}

![](../graphics/REB_Logo.png){fig-alt="Reaction Engineering Basics Logo" fig-align="center" width="200"}

## Variable BSTR Heating or Cooling {.cc}

Class 18 examines situations where the rate of heat exchange between the reacting fluid and the exchange fluid is varied over time. 

## Learning Outcomes {.ch}

After completing Class 18 you should...

* Understand the exchange fluid flow rate and other BSTR operating parameters can be varied over time 
* Be able to solve IVODEs with time-varying parameters numerically
